name: app-dark-social-media-slide-with-post-story-and-lifestyle-photo
title: Dark Social Media Slide with Post and Story
whatItIs: A dark slate slide titled Social Media with a plane progress bar, a paragraph, an Instagram-style post with a hiker and script 'Explore More', a blue story frame with a plane and sunrise and a Swipe Up button, and a wide lifestyle photo of a man on a sofa with a laptop.
whatItMeans: Showing post, story and lifestyle photography together proves the brand voice across social, and the dark slide makes the bright images pop.
techniques: Instagram post and story frames as mockups
Blue brand overlay on the story
Dark slate ground to lift the colour
bestFor: Social media sections in brand case studies

vocabulary.definition: A vertical panel with story-style chrome.
Handwriting-style lettering laid over a photo.
A photo of people in a natural setting using or evoking the product.
